title: Multi-Display Topologies, AST YAML Engine & Modular Store Architecture
description: Introduces full Central/Peripheral multi-display topology routing, shield unit detection with authentic physical keyboard previews, comment-preserving AST YAML manipulation for west manifests and build configs, and a modularized state architecture with enhanced pixel editor navigation.
highlights: Multi-display topologies with Central and Peripheral display assignment mapping
Automated keyboard shield detection with 10+ authentic physical shield previews
Proportional coordinate remapping and collision resolution across screen geometry and orientation changes
AST-based YAML parser (yaml package) replacing regex operations for resilient config and manifest manipulation
Modularized Zustand stores decoupling preview, display config, and settings
High-performance pixel editor with integer zoom clamping, arrow-key selection dragging, and dual-canvas rendering

title: Public Release
description: First public release of Scyan ZMK Studio. A comprehensive visual IDE for designing 1bpp OLED displays, composing dynamic layout blocks, managing symbol and font atlases, previewing real-time typing with Corne split keyboards, and compiling directly to single-source-of-truth firmware headers.
highlights: Production-ready 2-Atlas visual builder and layout compiler for SSD1306 OLED screens
1-Click automated installation and clean removal of Scyan display module in ZMK keyboard repositories
Zero-configuration split keyboard simulator with Colemak & QWERTY keymap parsing
Extensive widget catalog: Oscilloscope WPM chart, Loop animations, Bongo Cat, Output status, and Battery gauges
Export symbols as animated GIF and transparent PNG; crisp multi-resolution brand assets

title: Firmware Module Automation & Cloud CDN Synchronization
description: Introduces one-click installation and uninstallation of the Scyan ZMK display module directly into your keyboard repository. Enhances repository caching with aggressive CDN bypasses for instant GitHub synchronization, lossless brand asset export, and in-app changelog navigation.
highlights: 1-Click automated install and clean uninstall for the scyan-zmk-module directly in zmk-config
All studio commits now carry the standard [Scyan Studio] prefix
Aggressive GitHub API & CDN cache-busting (no-store) to prevent stale branch conflict errors
Session storage and local layout cache automated cleanup upon module removal
Right-click context menu to export symbol groups as transparent PNG and animated GIF
Crisp multi-resolution PNG/SVG favicon ladder with integer pixel grid snapping and faint canvas grid guides

changes: Firmware module automation, cloud CDN synchronization, and brand asset export

title: GIF Animation Importer & Multi-Frame Slicing Engine
description: A major upgrade to the asset pipeline adding full support for animated GIFs. Imported frames are automatically packed into the Symbols Atlas, sliced into groups, and rendered live with the new Loop Animation widget.
highlights: Native client-side GIF parser with 1bpp dithering and transparent background handling
Loop Animation widget with runtime frame delay and dynamic frame-count scaling
Interactive crop bounding box with drag handles for fast sprite extraction
Automatic grouping and naming for multi-frame animation sequences
Firmware compiler integration: 16-bit sprite slice offsets, identifier sanitization, and Kconfig idle timeout sync

changes: Native client-side GIF animation importer and multi-frame slicing engine

title: UI Design System Overhaul & Modern Typography Engine
description: Complete visual redesign in electric cyan and dark slate, featuring an element reference catalog, mouse-targeted canvas zooming, and a modern proportional pixel typography system.
highlights: Unified dark UI design system with electric cyan accents, peripheral split UX, and responsive layout
Dual small/big font slots with support for accented Latin characters, digits, Japanese kana, and custom symbols
Proportional pixel font with live ghost typing preview in editor
Mouse-targeted canvas zooming and OLED display border guides

changes: UI design system overhaul and modern typography engine

title: Studio Onboarding, Ecosystem Architecture & Playground Mode
description: Adds repository discovery, locked studio validation flow, standalone Playground mode for unauthenticated visual testing, and formal ecosystem architectural contracts.
highlights: Repository onboarding flow with automated repo discovery and locked studio validation
Playground mode allowing free tab navigation and visual experimentation without repository credentials
Antigravity ecosystem documentation: AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and offline ZMK documentation
Canonical install header template loader (scyan_assets.install.h)

changes: Studio onboarding flow, ecosystem architecture, and playground mode

title: Dynamic Layout Blocks, Widget Instances & C Compiler
description: Introduces dynamic layout block composition for left/right OLED displays with Active and Idle states, reusable widget instances with template browser, and single-source-of-truth C header compilation.
highlights: Dynamic Layout Blocks system supporting Active and Idle display states for split keyboards
Widget instances architecture with template browser and cascade delete
Symbol Groups visual bundling and multi-slice drag-to-move
Oscilloscope heartbeat WPM Chart and unified Output Status widget
Reactive Bongo Cat widget template
Production C header compiler (scyan_assets.h) emitting discrete arrays with lossless round-trip metadata

changes: Dynamic layout blocks, widget instances, and C header compiler

title: Dual-Atlas Studio Foundation & Visual Layout Compiler
description: The initial foundation of Scyan ZMK Studio. Features an infinite 2-Atlas pixel editor (Symbols + Font), minimalist Corne 5x3 keyboard hardware simulator, and fine-grained GitHub token authentication.
highlights: Dual 1bpp Atlases (Font + Symbols) with infinite canvas and real-time pixel editing
Full Corne 5x3 keyboard hardware simulator with Colemak & QWERTY scan-code typing
Fine-grained GitHub OAuth and repository-scoped permissions flow
Variable-width Font Atlas architecture and character mapping

changes: Dual-Atlas Studio foundation, Corne split simulator, and GitHub OAuth flow
